translations.source_sense_description: dezelfde lettergreep een aantal malen herhalend moeilijk uit zijn woorden komen

glosses: To speak (words) with a spasmodic repetition of vocal sounds.

examples.text: He stuttered a few words of thanks.

glosses: To expel a gas with difficulty.

examples.text: I was stuttering after the marathon.
The engine of the old car stuttered going up the slope.

glosses: A speech disorder characterized by stuttering.

examples.text:
1626, Francis Bacon, Sylva Sylvarum, London: William Lee, IV. Century, p. 103,
And many Stutters (we finde) are very Cholericke Men; Choler Enducing a Drinesse in the Tongue.
